policy: Every statistical change to data/dataset.json after the frozen snapshot is recorded here and applied by tools/apply_revisions.py on top of a fresh extraction from the published bundle. A change is applied only when the value it replaces is exactly the value recorded in `from`; otherwise the tool refuses. Nothing is applied silently.

revisions.title: Post-remark examination results control
revisions.basis: On the record owner's instruction, the locked examination-result corrections in the figures corpus are reversed: the earlier published figures are the post-remark results, and the values that replaced them were recomputed from pre-remark tables. Each reversal is recorded as a new ledger entry; the superseded entry is kept with its status changed so the lineage stays visible. Locked entries concerning university applications, offers and destinations (C04, C07, C08, C09) are not examination results and are not affected.
